name: xrick
description: xrick is a clone of Rick Dangerous, Core Design's 1989 platform game about an Indiana Jones-style adventurer. Written by BigOrno between 1998 and 2002, it reproduces the original game in portable C code using SDL. The original graphics, maps and sounds still belong to the Rick Dangerous rights holders.
curiosities: Rick Dangerous was designed by Simon Phipps at Core Design, the studio that later created Tomb Raider.
Its author said he could not formally release the whole game under a free licence because he could not reach Core Design about the original assets.
xrick has been ported to many devices, including the Rockbox firmware for music players.
Rick Dangerous is known for traps that kill the player without warning, so levels are learned by trial and error.
story: Core Design released Rick Dangerous in 1989, a platformer that parodied Indiana Jones.
xrick is a fan remake that recreates the original game for modern systems.
It keeps a classic of British home computer games alive.
